selector.runner_up: Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS)
selector.rationale: Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction and symptoms like fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath support COVID-19 diagnosis

rejected.label: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS)
rejected.why: While symptoms like shortness of breath and low oxygen saturation are present, ARDS is not the most specific diagnosis given the direct evidence for COVID-19

rejected.label: Community-acquired pneumonia
rejected.why: Although pneumonia is suggested by chest radiography, the positive nasopharyngeal swab for COVID-19 makes it a more specific diagnosis

rejected.label: Obstructive sleep apnea-related hypoxemia
rejected.why: Hypoxemia could be related to sleep apnea, but the acute presentation with fever and anosmia points more directly to COVID-19

rejected.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea-Related Hypoxia
rejected.why: Similar to obstructive sleep apnea-related hypoxemia, the current symptoms are more directly explained by COVID-19
